name: winamp-tidal
description: Winamp-style skin (Webamp) that remote-controls Spotify and TIDAL
author: Lisandro Arrigoni

scripts.build:helper: dotnet build native/smtc-helper -c Release -o build/smtc-helper --nologo -v q
scripts.publish:helper: dotnet publish native/smtc-helper -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o build/smtc-helper --nologo -v q
scripts.dist: npm run publish:helper && npm run build && electron-builder --win
